in_hebrew.name: Olympia
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Olympia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Olympia was the site of the ancient Olympic Games, dedicated to Zeus. The name 'Olympia' derives from the Greek word 'olympos' meaning 'mountain'. As a name, Olympia represents strength, power, and divine inspiration.

in_greek.name: Ωλυμπία
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Olympia is derived from the name of the ancient Greek mountain, Olympus. Olympia was the site of the ancient Greek Olympic Games, which were held in honor of Zeus, the king of the gods.
